data.name: Sharvender
data.gender_notes: Sharvender is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sharvender is derived from the Sanskrit language, and it is composed of two parts. The first part 'Shar' means God, and the second part 'Vendra' means Peaceful or Prosperous. Thus, the name Sharvender signifies the God of Peace and Prosperity. The name Sharvender carries the meaning “God of Peace and Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharvender usually hope their child will grow to embody god of peace and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sharvender is believed to be a powerful and spiritual name in Hinduism. It is said to bring peace, prosperity, and strength to the one who bears it. It is a name that is often given to children who are destined to lead and to bring about positive change in the world.
data.etymology: Sharvender belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Peace and Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharvender total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
